description: Figure 2, titled "Performance with different chunking sizes," is a line plot that illustrates the relationship between the performance of a retrieval system and the size of the text chunks used. The x-axis, labeled "N," represents the chunk size in tokens and ranges from 200 to 1500, with a logarithmic scale. The y-axis, labeled "Performance," is a numerical score, though its specific unit is not provided. The plot displays a single line that trends upward from left to right, indicating that performance improves as the chunk size increases. The line starts at a performance value of approximately 20 when N is 200 and rises to a value of approximately 50 when N is 1500. The line is smooth and shows a consistent positive slope, suggesting a steady improvement in performance with larger chunk sizes.
